entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mishima was pretty useless.[n]You guys get anything?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I tried asking my sister, but[n]it seemed as though she didn't[n]know very much about them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She doesn't specialize in[n]cybercrime, after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I tried looking into[n]them too, but I didn't[n]come up with anything.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There are really just no leads.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, our opponent is truly elusive.
